entries.title: Ezekiel 10:1
segments: God is ever present among his people, disposing all the events which befall them to his own glory and the advancement of the cause of righteousness; the most terrible calamities come immediately from his hand, and are directed by his providence.  It is his will that we recognize him alike in mercies and judgments, and act habitually under a sense of his presence and absolute power to save or to destroy.

entries.title: Ezekiel 10:2
segments:
Under the cherub; that is, under the wings and hands of the four cherubim which were above the wheels. 
 
  Coals of fire--scatter them; a symbol of the pouring out of God's wrath upon Jerusalem.  Compare

entries.title: Ezekiel 10:3
segments: The right side; that is, the south, as the temple faced the east. Thus the prophet's view of the threshold was unobstructed.

entries.title: Ezekiel 10:4
segments: Went up from the cherub; see note on

entries.title: Ezekiel 10:5
segments: To the outer court; where the prophet was stationed, for he could not stand in the inner court by reason of the cloud.  Compare

entries.title: Ezekiel 10:8
segments: Under their wings; one under each wing.

entries.title: Ezekiel 10:13
segments: O wheel; they were addressed as possessing intelligence, and able to obey God's command.  Compare

entries.title: Ezekiel 10:14
segments:
Every one; of the cherubim. 
 
  The face of a cherub; this answers to "the face of an ox," in
.  Hence some have inferred that the cherubim over the ark of the covenant had the face of an ox.  These cherubim were symbolic beings, and not real angels.

entries.title: Ezekiel 10:20
segments: The living creature; that is, the fourfold living creature.
